name: The Guns of Northwatch
summary: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun in Ratchet wants the guns at Northwatch Hold silenced. Alliance gunners there have been blasting merchant vessels, so he sends you down the Merchant Coast to strike the artillery officers and bring back badges from fallen infantry.

sections.title: A Threat Along the Coast
sections.body: Northwatch Hold guards the southern Barrens coast for the humans of Theramore. Its soldiers watch Horde activity in Kalimdor, but fear has made them see every unfamiliar sail as a threat. The guns on the ramparts fire without warning at passing ships, endangering Ratchet's merchant traffic and its privateering vessels.

sections.title: Silencing the Ramparts
sections.body: Captain Brightsun wants the attacks on his ships answered. Captain Fairmount commands Northwatch, with Whessan and Smythe directing its guns. Defeating them and taking Theramore medals from the garrison throws the artillery into disarray and gives Ratchet's ships room to travel along the Merchant Coast.

faq.q: Why is Northwatch Hold shooting at ships from Ratchet?
faq.answer: Northwatch's human soldiers fear attacks from the Horde and regional pirates. Their gunners fire on nearly every vessel passing the Merchant Coast, whether it flies a neutral or hostile flag.
Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun is a high elf privateer captain based in Ratchet. He commands a merchant fleet and protects local shipping from rivals, including the Alliance forces at Northwatch Hold.

faq.q: Who are Captain Fairmount, Cannoneer Whessan, and Cannoneer Smythe?
faq.answer: Captain Fairmount commands Northwatch Hold's garrison. Whessan and Smythe direct the artillery batteries overlooking the sea. Defeating them disrupts the fortress's command and takes its heavy guns out of action.

Theramore Medals are military insignias carried by the human foot soldiers and guards at Northwatch Hold. Captain Brightsun asks for them as proof that the privateers' deaths have been avenged and the garrison decimated.

aliases: where are the guns of northwatch
faq.answer: Northwatch Hold sits on the southeastern bluffs of the Barrens, south of Ratchet along the Merchant Coast.

faq.q: Is Northwatch Hold officially part of Theramore?
faq.answer: Yes. Theramore established Northwatch Hold to secure a military foothold on mainland Kalimdor. Its isolated garrison acts with fierce aggression and suspicion toward those traveling through the Barrens.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can strike Northwatch Hold and blunt an aggressive Alliance fortification in the Barrens, securing Kalimdor's borders for your people.
As a human, you can see how isolation far from home strains Theramore's frontier garrisons and feeds reckless hostility.
